steps.objective:
Use this single maintained entrypoint for a fresh disposable CLOSE metrics fixture. It is manufactured workload setup, not representative remote survival, natural dispatch, attraction or performance-gain proof. Initial time and all sixteen inherited human bodies are conserved; four bandits and two cannibals have current hostile operations, while eight other home members and two independent NPCs remain distinct. The seed transform places complete native Mi-go encampment terrain, not actors, population tokens, signal, intent or active-work credit. The stalker and horde are additional distinct loads.

After actual World binding, both aborting body/report/claim preflights must pass before live input. Verify effective AUTOSAVE=false and RAID_PERFORMANCE_DIAGNOSTIC=normal and record other settings, including LLM intent state. Initial human bodies remain at home with zero-credit native clock adoption. Their native owner solves body-to-rally paths. structural_route_valid is a STRUCTURAL-SORTIE-only diagnostic and is false for these hostile reservations; last_advanced_minutes may remain unchanged during real travel. Neither field, empty local_handoff, ownership labels nor body counts establish movement or refusal. Observe actual poses, goals, paths, activation and current ownership. On a refusal retain the first actual native guard rather than waiting repeatedly or rewriting the world.

Qualify Mi-go work through the ordinary map-update/spawn consumer after load: take practical avatar steps that shift the map near the placed encampment at144,39/144,40. A pending new-content population with zero members is not a committed roster; initial map generation alone may leave it pending until this native consumer runs. Census genuine generated member identities, leases, body positions, health and owners before counting work. An ordinary physical brazier/fuel/fire near the player may establish a useful source; its actual packet, cap, exposure and reception must be measured, never supplied. Native local movement, targeting, observation, combat or authenticated operation progress is work; marker-only terrain, population count or an emitted signal is not. If native generation or eligibility refuses, preserve the exact guard, with no actor/token/clock injection or forced admission.

Establish simultaneous useful human and Mi-go work and ordinary stalker/horde activity, then a meaningful adjacent or inactive/load control preserving the same identities and current outcomes. Use practical avatar survival, care and setup with advertised native controls; do not replay completed paid or death stories. Keep physical source and player actively simulated. This close fixture does not meet the representative home-edge10/default15 requirement; any separate representative leg must. Do not broaden this metrics footing into another source-reception campaign.

Record actual active parties/members separately from sites, frozen/refused/dead bodies, stalkers and horde entities. Current active_sites/job_mix counters omit hostile reservations. Measure useful contiguous100/300-turn or guard-sized intervals and practical density as actual admission/capacity allow, not speculative10/20/50/100 labels. Frozen budgets remain mean100ms for100/300 turns,300-turnp95 250ms, uninterrupted5-game-minute native WALL45s, ordinary-actionp95 3s including transport and individual-spike review2s. Separate input, transport, save/load, actual simulation wall, process CPU, memory and logical IO; no retrospective allocation, threshold waiver or gain without a matched workload. Announce timed IO holds and retain decisive original packets and native boundaries before rotation; missing pairs remain missing, not reconstructed. No new profiler, continuous tracker or raw-growth campaign.

At useful progress save and close normally. Reenter the SAME saved result through the supported snapshot continuation and prove human/Mi-go identity, owner, body and clock continuity without reinstalling this fixture or replenishing activity. Do not use known-broken automatic post_relaunch. Finish finite current work or retain a concrete native guard/needed continuation honestly. Original Luna remains sole input under the assigned chaperone, one native game. No manual live-save/actor/history/lease/claim edits, guard weakening, source-cap tuning, native build or code change from this charter. Keep current product/save/packet dependencies and settle consumed temporary inputs through their owners. Whole mixed scaling/performance and RAID acceptance remain separate from this setup and any one interval.
